reviews.text: Very nice vet and staff, efficient and caring.
Amazing service! Every staff member is very friendly and knowledgeable. My baby had to do an emergency spay do to pyrometria and they took us in and did great job. I’m thankful for their staff

A level of compassion and humanity that deserves to be recognized

From the very first moment I contacted this clinic, even before I ever met the team in person, the care and attention I received were exceptional. But being there and experiencing everything firsthand exceeded all of my expectations.

I honestly don't have enough words to describe how beautiful it was to encounter people with such incredible compassion, kindness, patience, and genuine love for what they do. You can tell that they don't simply see animals as patients—they truly care about them and about the people who bring them in.

I have been to hospitals for human patients here in Houston, and unfortunately, I have rarely experienced the level of humanity, respect, warmth, and compassion that I experienced at this veterinary clinic. And that says so much.

I brought my cat Mika in to be spayed, and I left with an incredible sense of peace, knowing that she had been in the hands of people who truly do their work with love and dedication.

My sincerest congratulations and deepest gratitude to the entire team. From the bottom of my heart, I hope you can continue this beautiful work for many, many years, never lose the compassion that makes you so special, and that all the good you do for so many animals and their families comes back to you multiplied.

Thank you for existing, for serving, and for making a difference. ❤️🐾

With all my gratitude,
Ma-Ling & Mika 🐱❤️

The techs and Veterinarians are very compassionate and thorough with their exams. Front desk is very welcoming. I really enjoyed bringing my fur babies here.
Very nice and patient staff . Very affordable.

This is the place for affordable and high quality cat dentals (including xray)! I brought my 7 yr old cat, Herman, in for his first cleaning, and he ended up needing 2 extractions. The total cost was around $580 which is insanely affordable compared to how other vets are charging (in the thousands). The base cost for dental cleaning and xray is $400 (as of 09/2026).

I am so grateful I found this place, and I will continue to bring Herman here for as long as I can. I highly recommend this place. As someone who worked at a spay/neuter clinic, it is amazing to see they are providing dentals. They are truly meeting the needs of the community.

Thank you to every single person who works there. Your hard work does not go unnoticed.

Dr. Hanna and her staff are exceptional. Not only are the cost very reasonable but your pets receive excellence veterinary care. I've had vaccinations and 3 separate surgeries on my dogs and they treated my pets like they were their own.  Customer service is top notch.

The staff there is very kind and caring very nice environment did an excellent job taking care of my girls and I'm going back in 2 days take care of my boys I am grateful that you're there they helped so much
I foster dogs and Houston Spay & Neuter has been great for the most part!

I definitely recommend Houston Spay Neuter Clinic, especially if you’re looking for a more budget-friendly option for your fur babies! 🐾❤️

I’ve brought two of my fur babies here so far, and I’ve had a good experience with both. One is currently recovering, but everything has gone well so far. I’m also hoping to use them for a TNR situation in the future.

Their prices are very reasonable compared to what you’ll typically find at other veterinary clinics, and they’re pretty thorough and informative about the services they provide. They also work with you, which I really appreciate.

One thing to keep in mind is that communication is primarily through email or text. You generally can’t speak with someone one-on-one unless you’re physically at the clinic, which can be a little difficult at times. That said, they do get back to you, so it’s more of an inconvenience than a major issue.

Also, a little FYI for anyone planning to go: paying cash can be more cost-effective, since there is an additional fee when paying by credit card. The clinic is understandably very popular, so be prepared for them to be busy.

Overall, I’ve been happy with my experiences there and would definitely recommend checking them out if you need affordable spay/neuter services for your pets. 🐱🐶💕
